A clamp-on desk cup holder: a C-shaped clamp that grips a desk edge up to 30 mm thick, and an open-top cup of 80 mm inner diameter beside it that a drink drops into.
A wall key rack: a backplate 150 x 50 mm with two screw holes and four hooks that stick out horizontally 25 mm from it and turn up at the end.
A wall-mounted hair dryer holster: a backplate with two screw holes and a 90 mm inner-diameter ring that the dryer drops into from above, nozzle down.
